name: Card wallet, oxblood
summary: Four cards and a few folded notes, in vegetable-tanned leather that takes the shape of what you carry. Stitched by hand, one at a time.

care.title: When is it back?
care.description: The next batch is being cut now. Leave your email and we write once, when it is in stock.

care.title: How do I look after the leather?
care.description: Nothing, mostly. If it dries out after a few years, a little neutral balm brings it back.

restock.text: Email me when it is back
